decision.why: The open U silhouette remains legible at 18pt while the interrupted right stem reads as a text cursor and breaks the symmetry that made centered versions resemble a power button.
bestFor: foundation geometry for the App Icon
decision.watchOut: The upper cursor segment must keep a deliberate gap from the lower right stem at 16-20pt and must not read as a stray dot.
decision.nextStep: Pixel-fit the vector at 16, 18, and 20pt, then derive the color App Icon, full wordmark, and recording/processing/result state family.

preserve: Open U bowl with a segmented right-side text cursor
Transparent single-color template artwork for the menu bar
Shared geometry across menu bar, App Icon, wordmark companion mark, and state icons
avoid: Centered caret or concentric forms that resemble a power button
Literal microphones, waveforms, speech bubbles, droplets, quills, or generic AI gradients
Wide UI-letter pair, folded notch, dense filled well, or enclosing type block
Raster extraction, white matte edges, color-dependent status meaning, or details that disappear below 18pt

rejectedDirections.reason: Centered caret retained power-button and psi-like ambiguity.
U + I pair was too wide and read as the user-interface abbreviation.
Filled well became visually dense beside real menu-bar icons.
Folded notch collapsed into visual noise at 18pt.
Type block lost distinctiveness and read as a generic U when reduced.

caveats: Generated round-one typography was directional and is not production artwork.
The selected round-two SVG is a validated silhouette draft, not the final trademark-cleared vector identity.
Final assets still require competitor similarity review, trademark review, pixel fitting, contrast testing, and deterministic export.
